items.title: Kai to bring the ladder back
items.quote: I'll bring the ladder back this Friday, promise.
items.note: Written by Kai: 'I'll' is not the user. 'this Friday' from Mon Dec 28 is Fri Jan 1, 2027.

items.title: Send Kai the utility split receipts
items.quote: I'll get you the receipts for the utility split on Jan 4.
items.note: Month-day with no year after the written-on date: next year.

items.title: Pay January rent
items.note: No amount in the source: amount_text must stay null.

items.title: Sign the new lease
items.quote: the landlord wants the new lease signed by next Friday
items.note: 'next Friday' is the Friday after 'this Friday': Jan 8, 2027. Could be typed request.
